pages.ja:
躊躇いはない。
セイバーの目を見つめたまま、彼女の視線に応えて、重い腕を振り下ろした。

pages.en:
There is no hesitation.

I hold Saber's gaze and answer it, bringing my heavy arm down.

pages.ja:
抵抗はなかった。
きっかりと一撃で、セイバーの命を止めた。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
She does not resist.

With one precise blow, I bring Saber's life to an end.
pages.mirrorMoon:
There’s no resistance.
I end Saber’s life with one blow.

」
思い出があった。
ちゃんと、今でも生きている温かさがあった。
忘れようのない、彼女の体温がすぐ近くにあってくれた。

pages.en:
“————————”

There were memories.

A warmth that lives within me even now.

Her unforgettable body heat had always been there, so close to mine.

pages.ja:
その記憶ごと彼女を殺めた。
自分の記憶を抉り、手の届かないところに投げ捨てた。
もう、二度と蘇る事はない。
二度と、彼女を思い出す事はない。
そんな事は、絶対に許されない。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
I killed her together with those memories.

I tore them out of myself and cast them somewhere beyond my reach.

They will never return.

I will never remember her again.

——That can never be forgiven.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I kill her along with those memories.
I search through my mind and throw them away to where I can’t find them again.
They’ll never return.
I’ll never recall her now.
Such a thing will never be forgiven.

pages.ja:
俺はこの道を選んだ。
桜を助ける為に他人を殺した。
親しい人を、最期まで俺を守ってくれた少女を、この手で殺めた。
後悔も懺悔も許されない。
……誰かの味方をするという事。
ただ一つ愛する者の為、大切なものを奪い続ける。

pages.en:
I chose this path.

To save Sakura, I killed another person.

With these hands, I killed someone dear to me—the girl who protected me until her final moment.

Neither regret nor penance is permitted.

…This is what it means to take one person's side.

For the sake of the one person I love—my selfish desire—I will go on robbing others of what they hold dear.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I chose this path.
I killed someone else to save Sakura.
Using my own hands, I killed someone who protected me until the very end.
Neither regret nor a confession will bring forgiveness.
…This is what it means to ally with someone.
I’ll keep sacrificing important things for the one I love.

pages.ja:
その先に。
喪ったものに見合う輝きなど在りはしない。
pages.jaRuby:
その先に。
喪ったものに見合う輝きなど在りはしない。
pages.en:
And at the end of that path,

there can be no radiance bright enough to equal what I have lost.
pages.mirrorMoon:
And on this path…
There’s nothing brilliant enough to make up for what I’ve lost.

pages.ja:
「
でも、セイバー」
喪ったものに見合う幸せを、一生涯求め続ける。
ツケは溜まっていく一方で、いつか動けなくなるのは目に見えている。
それでも
みっともなく、滑稽で無価値なまま、奪い続けた責任を果たしてみせる。

pages.en:
“——But, Saber…”

For the rest of my life, I will keep seeking a happiness equal to what I lost.

The debt will only mount. The day when I can no longer move is plainly inevitable.

Even so——wretched, absurd, and worthless, I will fulfill my responsibility for everything I have taken.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“But Saber
”
I’ll search all my life for happiness that can measure up to what I’ve lost.
I’ll keep losing more than I gain, and I know I’ll stop someday.
But
I’m going to take responsibility for stealing things away, even if I’m pathetic, comical, or meaningless.

pages.ja:
幸福が何処にあるのかは判らない。
ただ、終わりが見えなくても、諦める事だけはしないと誓う。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
I do not know where happiness lies.

I swear only that even if I can see no end, I will never give up.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I don’t know where I can find happiness.
But I swear to myself that I’ll never give up, even if I can’t see the end.

…The weight against the dagger disappears.

The black swordswoman remains silent to the end. Still staring vaguely up at me, she sinks into the black shadow.
